title: Marked stack deformations and their tangent-operation relations
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring and $k$ a field of finite type as an $R$-algebra. Use the marked Artinian test category $\mathcal C_{R,k}$ and its square-zero algebras $k[V]$ of [def-sfb-artin-deformation-test-category]. Let $\mathcal F$ be a category over $\mathit{Sch}/\operatorname{Spec}R$, using the fibred-groupoid conventions of [def-sfb-algebraic-moduli-stack], and let $x$ lie over $\operatorname{Spec}k$. For $A$ in $\mathcal C_{R,k}$, define the marked category to have objects arrows $x\to\eta$ lying over the residue immersion $\operatorname{Spec}k\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ and morphisms arrows $\eta\to\eta'$ over the identity commuting with the markings. If $\mathcal F$ is fibred in groupoids, this is the groupoid of objects $\eta$ with a specified isomorphism $\eta|_k\cong x$. Define its class set as the quotient by marked isomorphism and its tangent set by evaluating at $k[k]$. For a residue-preserving map $f:A\to B$, the pullback relation between marked objects $\eta$ over $A$ and $\zeta$ over $B$ means there exists an arrow $\zeta\to\eta$ over $\operatorname{Spec}f$ commuting with the markings. In a fibred groupoid this is the usual pullback relation. The zero relation requires a projection from the marked dual-number object to $x$ over the inclusion $k\to k[k]$ splitting its marking. Scalar transport uses $(b,v)\mapsto(b,cv)$. A pair-lift is a marked object over $k[k\times k]$ whose restrictions along the two projections represent the two prescribed tangent classes. The sum relation requires such a pair-lift whose transport along addition $k\times k\to k$ represents the result. The maps on square-zero tests are the residue-preserving algebra maps $k[V]\to k[W]$, $(b,v)\mapsto(b,\lambda(v))$, induced by $k$-linear maps $\lambda:V\to W$. These are definitions of categories, quotients and relations; existence and uniqueness of transports or pair-lifts are not assumed.
